title: Frame every line of full-note references as untrusted terminal data
outcome: Frame every line of full-note references as untrusted terminal data
acceptance: A show --notes reference containing newline next/reminders headings and commands stays inside its indented data block; structured JSON preserves the exact reference and both receipts remain bounded.
